annotations.title: Recent status changes and news feed

description: Latest status changes in the registry (last 90 days, with source) and the latest items of DiscoverIA's feed (last 30 days: sciences, models and labs, apps, devices).

kind.description: 'status' for status changes only, 'feed' for feed items only, 'all' for both. Default 'all'.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

limit.description: Maximum items per list, 1 to 50. Default 20.

name: recent_changes
title: Recent status changes and news feed
